settings.title: Settings
settings.reset.title: Reset to the default: {value}
settings.idle_close.hint: Closes idle sessions to free worker memory; later requests reopen them from disk.
settings.park_ttl.hint: Cancels turns stuck waiting for client tool results and frees the worker slot.
settings.direct: Allow direct connections for accounts with no proxy at all
settings.outbound.note: Route order: egress rules → account proxy → fallback proxy → direct (if allowed).
settings.warmup.enable: Send a minimal request when a weekly quota pool is full
settings.warmup.note: Google only starts the 7-day reset timer only after a weekly pool is first used. When enabled, agyrelay will try to send a single short request to start the timer. Applies only to in-rotation accounts.
settings.egress_rules.note: One mihomo-style rule per line (TYPE,VALUE,TARGET). Types: DOMAIN, DOMAIN-SUFFIX, DOMAIN-KEYWORD, DOMAIN-WILDCARD, DOMAIN-REGEX, IP-CIDR (no DNS), DST-PORT, MATCH. Targets: REJECT, REJECT-DROP, PROXY, DIRECT, PASS, or http://[user:pass@]host:port.
settings.capture.enable: Record agy's requests to Google and their responses
settings.capture.limit: Keep at most this much of each response (MiB)
settings.capture.note: Stores full upstream request and response bodies in the database for 24 hours (view them on the Calls page). Turning this off deletes existing captures.
settings.risk.enable: Reject requests that Google's risk control refuses
settings.refuse_harness.note: Rejects requests containing built-in system prompts or wrapper blocks from coding harnesses (OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, etc.).
settings.signatures.note: JSON array of {"name", "phrases", "words"}. "phrases" match as substrings; "words" match whole words only (so "pi" won't match "api"). Matching ignores case and formatting.
settings.signatures.invalid: Harness signatures are not valid JSON: {error}
flagged.title: System prompts risk control
flagged.note: When Google's risk system treats a request as risky (usually because of the system prompt), it returns a 429 without a Retry-After. agyrelay flags those prompts for 24 hours and blocks matching requests before they reach any account.
flagged.keep.hint: Keep refusing this prompt until you untick this.
flagged.legacy_only: Recorded before upstream call capture on risk control; only the client system prompt was saved.
flagged.delete.confirm: Delete flagged prompt {hash}? This cannot be undone.
settings.prices.note: USD per 1M tokens. When Cache write is set, all uncached input uses that price (agy does not report cache writes separately).

mode.continue: Delivered tool results to the parked agy turn
mode.warm: Appended new messages to the existing agy session
mode.rewind: Rewound the agy session to the shared prefix (edited/dropped history or retried turn), then sent new messages
mode.fresh: Started a new agy session (first turn, no history)
mode.replay: Started a new agy session with full history flattened as text
replay.no_snapshot: No session holds this conversation's history: new to the relay, idle past the snapshot TTL, or the history was edited
replay.tools_changed: The client's tool set differs from the session's
replay.warm_failed: The session could not be reopened or rewound
replay.retry: An earlier attempt failed on another account
replay.switch_failures: The account failed too many requests, so the conversation moved to another account
replay.switch_definite: The account could not serve the conversation (quota, sign-in or model), so it moved to another account

status.key_limit: The API key hit its spending limit

status.overloaded: Upstream model capacity is temporarily exhausted
status.unavailable: No account was free, or an internal check failed
status.forbidden: The API key may not use this model

status.invalid_request: The request was rejected as invalid
status.risk_control: Google's risk control refused the request's system prompt; the prompt is flagged and refused here
